nom: Dickinson's Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater

avis.texte: This stuff is beyond amazing! I have only been using it for a few days now, and between switching off with their Pore Perfecting Toner (I use this in the morning before applying makeup and the Pore Perfecting Toner at night after removing my makeup) I am 50 years old and I swear it has taken 10 years off my skin! I use them with exfoliating cotton rounds on my face, neck and chest areas. It has evened out my skin tone, my aging spots are already starting to fade, and I am glowing! I can see why people rave about this stuff and swear by it! I can see why the smell might bother some people, but I don't mind it. I also have pretty oily skin, and this also helps with that, as well. Don't hesitate to give this a try! I only wish I had started using it much sooner!
My favorite. Clean & not strong. Doesn't strip your skin. Good clean scent. Refreshing.

avis.titre: Excellent Toner at a Good Price!
avis.texte: I've been purchasing Dickinson's Witch Hazel for years now. It works just as well as the more expensive micellar waters. I use Albolene cream cleanser, and then Dickinson's rosewater afterward. My skin retains so much more moisture this way. Dickinson's Witch Hazel contains no alcohol, and it's very inexpensive.

I use this alone on a cotton round when I just want to refresh, or following a face wash. It's gentle and refreshing. I do find the scent a bit much but not enough to stop using this product. Very good value

I have dealt with oily skin my entire life. It was hard to find products that wouldn't create more oil. I was the girl who would use those oil papers daily. It was bad. Since using Dickinson's Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater, my skin has had way less oil. I use it every morning and sometimes at night depending on how oily my skin is in the evening. You don't need a lot for your skin. I definitely recommend the toner, especially for those who have oily skin.
I really love this toner . It’s cheap , you get a lot and it’s very hydrating. I like how it feels on your face and it helps with removing makeup up .
I really liked this product. It softens my skin and the smell is awesome! However the item arrived leaked.

Why didn't I find this sooner! I've acne-prone, dry, splotchy ageing skin. This helps soothe after I clean, tones down redness and keeps the spots at bay. Also BRILLIANT as a deodorant. I put some under my armpits at night, let it dry, then put on mild deodorant. Typically by morning I'd smell sweaty, but this product keeps my pits stink - free. Some days i just use it by itself a couple of times a day in place of deodorant. Love it! Also bonus points for it being alcohol free.

Meine empfindliche Haut verträgt das Gesichtswasser sehr gut. Ich benutze es abends und morgens dann ein Rosenwasser. Seitdem hat sich meine zu Rötungen und Unreinheiten neigende Mischhaut so extrem verbessert, dass ich mittlerweile sogar ohne Make-up das Haus verlassen kann. Daran wäre früher überhaupt nicht zu denken gewesen. Meine Ü50-Haut ist heute wesentlich besser als in jüngeren Jahren.
This sn amazing product and leaves my skin feeling soft and cleaner. Thank you.
Excelente producto!! Me encanta como deja la piel, tiene un aroma muy agradable, me gusta porque no tiene alcohol, es una maravilla, lo recomiendo.
High quality toner, lovely rose smell! Gentle on the skin, non-drying.

avis.titre: Hydrating toner with rose water 2 pack
avis.texte: Perfect! Toner is vital to skincare, thus was packaged with paper to avoid moving during shipment.

Is better than plain witch hazel in terms of drying, but i mix this stuff with my rose water toner b/c im poor and it makes it stretch. The real lifesaver for sensitive skin is rose water, Dickenson's! Get thee on the rose water train, minus witch hazel! You'll make more money if you do. I would also buy your product, as it would hopefully be less than the 11 buck bottles of rose water toner *shrugs*. Rose water toner is less drying than toners with witch hazel, and DEFINATELY less drying than those containing alcohol. Just a fun fact! I do love the lower price point though of this Dickenson's stuff, 4 bucks a bottle is a godsend. Thank you.

avis.titre: Great for acne and hyper pigmentation
avis.texte: I am so in love with this product. This is actually my second time buying it if you are someone that struggles with acne or hyper pigmentation this product is a must have ‼️
Excellent product for the skin. Was surprised how big the bottle is

Struggling with body odor ? This is one of the best products you can use to help leaves you fresh the whole day and also tones your bikini area , it can also be used on your entire body face, neck , arm , boobs , vagina area (outside) , inner thight , booty etc
Really love it, my face is so smooth since I started using it and it’s not drying out my face I’ll get another one soon.

Ok folks! This stuff is legit. I went from perfect skin to horrible awful skin for the last year. Have tried so many things. Special soaps, homemade stuff, doctor prescribed cream along with medication, masks, toners, several different lotions, face washes...it has been a brutal battle and not to be overly dramatic, has really affected(negatively) many aspects of my life. Thank God for the mask mandate, I was able to cover the mess. HOWEVER, the reviews for this toner and the research I did on it sold me so I tried it. ONE WEEK later my skin is the clearest it's been in over a year. It's so soft, my pores are smaller, I feel like it's helping with my scarring and discoloration too. I have extremely sensitive skin as well. This product does not sting my eyes does not sting my face leaves no sticky residue. I really hope I'm not jinxing myself, this is a incredible product and has worked quite quickly. Definitely worth a try! Good luck.
I tried it out this morning but noticed when I open the box that the cap to the bottle was broken… Overall good product, just needs to be packaged better.

It is the only witch hazel I will use! I've even got my husband using it! Which means now I have to buy it more often now. It has helped his skin, because he gets ingrown hairs, and I have weird combo skin. My skin looks and feels great. It has helped lighten the dark spots, which is fantastic! Great for after a shave, everywhere!😁

I recently got this because I heard witch hazel is really good for pimples, I barely used it today and honestly I felt like it took off a lot of dirt from my face that was bare the only thing on it was oil from earlier, if you look at the second picture that’s all the funk it got off........ one thing is it’s burns, there is a tingling sensation, so if you have sensitive skin I recommend don’t using it, I have sensitive skin but it didn’t make me break out or anything
I really like how this product feels on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and balanced. I have large pores and this seems to make them smaller. I will definitely repurchase!
Beware not well packaged & lid breaks easy, arrived in pieces, but box was in good condition? Bummer have to send it back, need a working lid.

avis.titre: I bought to use as a toner. Overall satisfied
avis.texte: I bought this product as a toner. It is an excellent size for the price. I did not note much of a rose smell. Overall a good product for the price.

For what it’s worth I’ve tried everything. It seemed like the older I got my skin kept getting worse. Well not any better. I’ve been using this once in the morning and again before bed for a few months now. My face isn’t as red or broken out so I’m pleased with it. My face is somewhat dry after using it but it’s always been on the dry side.

It came in a sealed bottle. The smell wasn’t that great but if you’re familiar with the witch hazel smell, I guess it’s normal. Although it lingers and I still smell it an hour after using it. I have sensitive skin so it did sting a little but in a good way. Not like a burning sensation. I also noticed that it shrunk my pores. So far so good.
The bottle arrived with a broken cap, but because of the seal it didn’t leak! Now just need to find a different bottle to put it in…
This is gentle enough to use daily, very hydrating but I always follow up with jergens hydrating lotion. Smells pleasant but if you have any cuts it will sting
This is the only toner I've been using for years. I use it everyday. It makes my face feel clean and smell like a rose.
I love this toner; it's alcohol-free and gentle on my skin. I found this toner while searching on Amazon. If you are looking for a toner that is gentle on the skin, try this toner.
Have a weird little feeling after applying on the skin, but it’s fine. Gets the job done.
This is a good product. It removed all my makeup will the solution on a few cotton balls and leaves my skin feeling fresh.

This toner would be perfect if they made it fragrance-free, but whatever chemicals they're calling fragrance burns and makes my skin break out in red bumps. I've used similar toners that were fragrance free and had great results, but I was hoping this would be a cheaper alternative. Unfortunately, the FDA allows companies to put all kinds of nasty chemicals, preservatives, and microplastics under the label "fragrance," so who knows what's in it? My SO came in later and complained that he could smell it from the other room and it gave him a headache.

Like for most, this product caught my eye because of the price. I was previously using Thayers, which is a great product for sensitive skin, but ranging from $10 to $15 for a 12 oz bottle, it gets a bit pricey. That said, I bought this hoping it would be a good replacement toner for me since I have sensitive skin that burns and peels with harsh toners. So far, this product has worked well! It does not burn and has not made me peel. Frankly, I think it has done wonders for my skin and cleared it up significantly. Arguably, even better than Thayers! I recommend giving it a shot. I'm definitely buying this product again!
Really good, inexpensive toner for face. Love the way my facial skin feels!

This stuff works wonders if you have oily skin or kind of big pores. I cool mine in the fridge for extra freshness on my skin. The scent is not overpowering but has a slight floral & herbal smell. I highly recommend this product.
This toner is sooo good and leaves skin feeling hydrated, clean, and glowy.

avis.titre: Great toner & I love the price tag too.
avis.texte: Love it! Nothing like other toners that feel harsh and too dry on your face. This one didn’t to me and I love the smell. I only feel fresh and clean after not dry.

I normally use the original one but wanted to try this because heard it smells good. There’s too many added ingredients compared to the original, which only has witch hazel, so that’s what probably burns my skin as I have sensitive skin. Plus, I think the original smells better anyway.
Both items tops are broken off and one of the products spilled
Everything was great except for the broken bottle. Love the product, maybe needs some cushioning in the box when its shipped
Highly moisturizing, didn’t irritate my skin, doesn’t feel dried out .

I have very sensitive irritated skin and bought this thinking this would give some relief. Advertised as “alcohol free” but the 3rd ingredient listed is Phenoxyethanol, which is literally a type of ether alcohol. Beware to those with irritated skin because this BURNS. Wish I would’ve read the ingredients first because this was a waste. But to be fair, there is a nice rose scent so if you don’t mind the “skin on fire” burning sensation then this is the product for you.

I purchased this product because I read that it was very good for sensitive skin. I received it a few days ago and started using it, but to my surprise my skin started to break out. So, it’s safe to say that it’s not good for sensitive skin. Very disappointing. Waste of money😒
No me gusto el producto me irrito mi piel dejandola roja y grasosa solo dos veces lo use
This product really irritated my skin, so I proceeded to scan it on my ingredients app. Turns out it has unnatural ingredients and the fragrance smell they add smells very artificial.

avis.titre: Exactly what is pictured. Wow love the smell
avis.texte: Exactly what is pictured. Definitely smells like Rosewater🌹Wow! Love the smell.

So the bottle I received actually had rosewater added to it and with the addition to that different ingredients (some which are actually irritants for my skin) so just keep in mind the bottle shown isnt what you get.
So this really dries out my skin which will eventually make me look older so I have to stop using this really waste my money

avis.auteur: I got an allergic reaction to the produc
avis.titre: Would not recommend for ANY sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I got an allergic reaction to the product and it caused redness all around my face
Love the toner! Works so good especially for hyperpigmentation and uneven skin tone
Lid was busted in several pieces. Unable to close after removing seal.

It is refreshing on skin, but my skin is incredibly sensitive. I’m going back through the products that I use and checking the ingredients. This one says it’s alcohol free but the last ingredient on the label is some form of ethanol, which of course is alcohol. Having worked in pharmaceutical research for four regrettable years I know under certain limits chemicals don’t have to be listed….for it to be listed it seems it can’t be alcohol free?

I loved it so I reordered when my first bottle was almost over. But to my dismay, the smell of new one is horrible, chemical-like, not at all delicate rose-like that of the previous one. The only difference in the ingredients I can see between both bottles is Organic Aloe Leaf Extract vs Non-Organic. Pictures attached. Fortunately, I have both to compare, you can’t miss the huge difference in smell. I wonder what else may be different, which I can't see yet. Did I get a fake? Or did the formulation change? Or Dickinson is not consistent between their batches? I'm not sure. But they just lost a loyal customer. 😔

It doesn’t matter which Dickinson’s Toner I decide to purchase, I love the clean hydrating feeling it brings to my face and body after washing. I’ll even wash my face midday and put this on afterwards just to feel refreshed. My skin feels especially dry depending on the season, so this helps with moisture retention when I use it with my thicker body balms. It doesn’t have any unnecessary fragrance or smells and it’s alcohol free.

This is my go-to skin toner. It's such a great product, I get compliments on my skin all the time. It's very gentle but effective at toning and evening your complexion, I even use it on scars. I buy a new bottle every few months since I transfer it to a spray bottle which makes it last so much longer.
Love this astringent cleared my skin. Very cooling and refreshing
La tapa se rompió en el primero uso. La fragancia no es muy agradable, arde un poco la cara a pesar de que no tengo piel sensible.

avis.titre: production date 2018 it has been in amazon warehouse more than 2 years
avis.texte: There is a label "2016 best beauty changers" It is 2021 are you kidding me? Why not 2019 best beauty changers instead of 2016?
